analytics_options.summary_template: {{ data.totals.signups_30d }} new signups in the last 30 days across {{ data.totals.monitors }} active monitors, {{ data.totals.checks_run_24h }} checks run in the last 24h.
analytics_options.highlights_template: [{% for p in data.top_posts[:limit] %}{"label": {{ (p.title + " (" + p.reads|string + " reads)")|tojson }}, "url": {{ ("https://pingowl.example.com/blog/" + p.slug)|tojson }}}{% if not loop.last %},{% endif %}{% endfor %}]

brand_description: PingOwl is a cron job and uptime monitoring service for developers: schedule checks, get a 'dead man's switch' alert when a job fails to run, and see history and latency per monitor.
agent_goal: Grow organic signups from developers searching for monitoring and reliability topics.
